dct_description_sm: The purpose of this project is to: 1) Improve our knowledge of the ice regime in the Arctic in relation to climate change; 2) Document natural variability and distribution of the local ice cover (ice-in and ice-out date, ice cover duration, ice types and characteristics); 3) Establish long-term ice monitoring in collaboration with communities and schools; 4) Collect local ecological knowledge (LEK) through interviews with local experts conducted by students in the classroom or as homework.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Schools
dct_title_s: Community-based ice monitoring in Nunavik in collaboration with Kativik School Board
